page.layout: One page of text. Above the text: a running head at top left, a page number at top right, and a decorative ornament. Below the ornament: a title in capitals with a subtitle, then "LIBER II." Below that: five stanzas of verse in one column, with a large decorated initial P. A gathering signature sits at the lower right.
page.notes: The decorated initial P is joined to the first word, so it reads PHOEBUS. Verse lines are run together within each stanza, since the scan gives no line-break markup. Line-end punctuation is kept as printed. The signature "C. j." is printed at the lower right and is transcribed as "C. j". The word "Umbrásque" carries its printed accent. The running head "GVISIACA." is copied as GUISIACA because the capital V is a vowel. The title is one head and LIBER II is a second head, since they are separate lines.
